metric_scope.cold: per NPU: request 0 admission through request 5 completion; six-request TTFT cohort and six-request compute busy time
metric_scope.warm: per NPU: request 1 admission through request 5 completion; request 1--5 TTFT cohort and request 1--5 compute busy time
metric_scope.ttft: completion minus admission; external arrival queue wait excluded
metric_scope.utilization: compute busy / per-NPU cohort window, then equal-weight mean across all 128 NPUs
metric_scope.shared_window_utilization_diagnostic: cohort compute busy summed across all NPUs / (NPU count * one common cohort window from the earliest per-NPU cohort start to the latest completion)
metric_scope.warm_common_window_limitation: the shared warm envelope starts at the earliest request-1 admission, which is still policy-dependent; a strict steady-state comparison requires a fixed wall-clock window after a common burn-in
metric_scope.warm_exposed_io_stall: per warm request: TTFT minus compute-only TTFT; requests 1--5 are averaged equally, and time after each NPU finishes its own stream is excluded
